cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need light to work. It's just faulty wiring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel that. Ask the house about overtime; we need its agreement before booking your evening shifts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need light to work. It's just faulty wiring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel that. Ask the house about overtime; we need its agreement before booking your evening shifts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop lifting the sofa. The keys have made themselves invisible because you're angry with them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're jingling under this cushion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they've heard you. Put the cushion down and apologize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologize, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No checking. Tell them we trust them to come out when they're ready.

cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The cups are floating. I'll tie them down while you rescue breakfast. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You flicked that gravity switch reaching for the toaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Could've been the toaster. Give me the string; I'll secure everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole table's rising. Hold my ankles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got you. I'll anchor us to the radiator. Let's list what floated, not who touched what.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cups are floating. I'll tie them down while you rescue breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You flicked that gravity switch reaching for the toaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could've been the toaster. Give me the string; I'll secure everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole table's rising. Hold my ankles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got you. I'll anchor us to the radiator. Let's list what floated, not who touched what.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll feed the little demon. You get our curtains out of its mouth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It appeared when you read that novelty mug aloud.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Those mugs say all sorts. I'll fetch crackers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only eats words. It's chewing the lease.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll swap in the mug and save our deposit. No need to preserve every possible clue.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The ghost's waiting at our breakfast table. Do we have cereal? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it haunting our kitchen? We're already late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then give it the instant porridge. I'll find a bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would a dead person need feeding? I'm taking the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it in a travel cup. You can drop it at the cemetery on your way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The ghost's waiting at our breakfast table. Do we have cereal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it haunting our kitchen? We're already late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give it the instant porridge. I'll find a bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would a dead person need feeding? I'm taking the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it in a travel cup. You can drop it at the cemetery on your way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hold this bucket under the seascape. I'll get towels before the gallery floor floods.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is a painting leaking? I said we should buy a print.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can choose the replacement. Tilt the bucket toward the waves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are there fish? This bucket's nearly full.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fetch the aquarium from reception. I'll hold this one until you're back.

cards.title: Borrowed Authority

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let's prepare the chair for our visitor from tomorrow. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says they can't arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. A chair won't hurt while the calculation finishes being pessimistic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered the final number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we can see the next useful task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's prepare the chair for our visitor from tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says they can't arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A chair won't hurt while the calculation finishes being pessimistic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered the final number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we can see the next useful task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The model cloud produced one drop. Let's build the welcome tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That doesn't prove the full rain machine works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It proves the tray has a purpose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The forecast looks terrible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the small success where we can still see it.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Did you notice the shadow reaching the door first? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'd rather hear your order of events.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, it moved before the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can admit I held the door for it.

beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you notice the shadow reaching the door first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd rather hear your order of events.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, it moved before the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can admit I held the door for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you send this soup back, did you notice anything moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm complaining about cold noodles. What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me whether one waved. I need your word before I explain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It waved me closer. I'm still not eating it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll understand why I've ordered it lunch. Could you ask whether it wants your bread?
